name: bg-stractium
title: Stractium Background
description: A full-bleed animated 3D backdrop: a dark red and teal organic mass that continuously morphs between a smooth sphere and a burst of blade-like spines. The viewpoint drifts and follows the pointer.
use: A marketing hero or splash screen needs a moving 3D backdrop without shipping image assets.
avoid: A costly per-pixel ray march never idles, and its fixed pale sky fights dark themes and white text.
a11y: Decorative canvas with no ARIA role or reduced-motion check, and the animation never stops. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pale blue-white sky gradient fills the frame behind a large glossy form in dark red, teal and silver. In some frames it is a smooth sphere; in others it bursts into layered, feather-like fins and floating shards. White text reads Stractium over the middle.
behaves: Runs unattended: the form slowly unfurls from a sphere into spiny blades and back. Moving the pointer shifts the camera angle, and the drifting viewpoint makes the shards catch the light.
customise: Hue, saturation, brightness, speed, pointer sensitivity, damping and noise opacity/scale are props; the shader geometry itself needs a source edit.
weight: heavy: Ray-marches up to 250 steps per pixel every frame.
